summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting two routine operational events: (1) the replacement of collateral custodian and securities intermediary from State Street to Computershare under its existing Credit Agreement, and (2) an increase in the maximum committed amount from $450M to $550M under that same facility. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special situation is present. The filing contains no change of control, shareholder vote, or strategic review. This is a standard credit facility administration—a material definitive agreement and associated debt obligation update. No special situation exists; category is None.
